instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: Elicitation Practice, Prototyping and SRS Organisation
topic_ar: ممارسة الاستخلاص والنمذجة الأولية وتنظيم المواصفة

questions.question: During a brainstorming session, when is evaluation allowed?
questions.question_ar: أثناء جلسة العصف الذهني، متى يُسمح بالتقييم؟
questions.explanation: Brainstorming bans criticism while ideas are generated; evaluation happens afterwards.
questions.explanation_ar: العصف الذهني يمنع النقد أثناء توليد الأفكار، والتقييم يأتي بعده.

questions.question: What must participants bring to a FAST session?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يجب أن يحضر المشاركون إلى جلسة FAST؟
options: the finished SRS here too now here
written lists of objects and services
a signed final contract again again
a working prototype now here too now here
options_ar: عقد نهائي موقّع هنا مجدداً مجدداً
نموذج أولي عامل الآن هنا أيضاً
options_en: the finished SRS here too now here
written lists of objects and services
a signed final contract again again
a working prototype now here too now here
questions.explanation: FAST requires preparation: each participant arrives with written objects, services and constraints.
questions.explanation_ar: FAST تتطلب تحضيراً: كل مشارك يأتي بقوائم مكتوبة بالكائنات والخدمات والقيود.

questions.question: What does a FAST workshop deliver?
options: the compiled source code too now too
the finished test plan here again
a raw unranked idea list now here
options_en: the compiled source code too now too
the finished test plan here again
a raw unranked idea list now here
questions.explanation: FAST evaluates and ranks inside the workshop, so it ends with priorities and a preliminary scope.
questions.explanation_ar: FAST تقيّم وترتّب داخل الورشة، فتخرج بأولويات ونطاق أولي.

questions.question: Why is a prototype built during requirements analysis?
questions.question_ar: لماذا يُبنى نموذج أولي في مرحلة تحليل المتطلبات؟
options: to replace the design phase too
to measure code quality now again
options_en: to replace the design phase too
to measure code quality now again
questions.explanation: A prototype gives the user something concrete to react to, which exposes vague requirements.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج الأولي يعطي المستخدم شيئاً ملموساً يتفاعل معه، فيكشف المتطلبات الغامضة.

questions.question: What happens to a throw-away prototype?
options: it is discarded after clarifying needs
it becomes the final product now again
it is shipped to the customer too
it is kept as documentation here here
options_en: it is discarded after clarifying needs
it becomes the final product now again
it is shipped to the customer too
it is kept as documentation here here
questions.explanation: A throw-away prototype exists only to settle the requirements, then it is dropped.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج المُهمَل يوجد فقط لتثبيت المتطلبات ثم يُترك.

questions.question: Which difficulty belongs to the present state of requirements practice?
questions.question_ar: أي صعوبة تنتمي إلى الحالة الراهنة لممارسة المتطلبات؟
questions.explanation: Tight schedules leave the analysis incomplete, which is one of the listed difficulties.
questions.explanation_ar: الجداول الضيقة تترك التحليل ناقصاً، وهذه إحدى الصعوبات المعروفة.

questions.question: Which step improves the practice of requirements engineering?
questions.question_ar: أي خطوة تحسّن ممارسة هندسة المتطلبات؟
options: skipping the review entirely now again here
options_en: skipping the review entirely now again here
questions.explanation: Requests must be ranked against the available time and resources, and change must be allowed.
questions.explanation_ar: الطلبات تُرتَّب حسب الوقت والموارد المتاحة، ويجب السماح بالتغيير.

questions.question: What does a requirements review validate?
options: the SRS against what users need
options_ar: الميزانية مقابل الخطة أيضاً الآن هنا
options_en: the SRS against what users need
questions.explanation: The review checks the SRS against the real needs of the stakeholders, before design begins.
questions.explanation_ar: المراجعة تقابل المواصفة مع الحاجات الحقيقية لأصحاب المصلحة، قبل بدء التصميم.
